description: This file defines the interface and classes for socket port management within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes class declarations for SocketPort, SocketStream, SocketDatagram, and SocketListner, along with their methods and internal state management, handling different socket types and platform-specific includes.

classes.name: SocketPort
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a network socket port, providing common interface and state management for different socket types and platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: SocketStream
classes.description: Derived class representing stream-oriented socket connections, such as TCP.

classes.name: SocketDatagram
classes.description: Derived class representing datagram-oriented socket connections, such as UDP.

classes.name: SocketListner
classes.description: Class managing listening sockets, accepting incoming connections, and handling socket events.

classes.name: SocketListner::Handler
classes.description: Internal handler class for managing individual listening socket instances.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the socket port.

methods.name: RemoteNode
methods.description: Sets the remote node address for the socket.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the socket type (DATAGRAM, STREAM, etc.).

methods.name: IsListening
methods.description: Checks if the socket is in listening state.

methods.name: IsConnecting
methods.description: Checks if the socket is in connecting state.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the socket is suspended.

methods.name: IsForcedClosing
methods.description: Checks if the socket is in a forced closing state.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the socket is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the socket is closed.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the socket has encountered an error.

methods.name: LocalNode
methods.description: Returns the local node address.

methods.name: LocalNode (setter)
methods.description: Sets the local node address.

methods.name: RemoteNode
methods.description: Returns the remote node address.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local host address as string.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote host address as string.

methods.name: ReceivedNode
methods.description: Returns the node ID of the last received packet.

methods.name: ReceivedInterface
methods.description: Returns the interface index of the last received packet.

methods.name: SendBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the configured send buffer size.

methods.name: ReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the configured receive buffer size.

methods.name: SocketSendBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the socket's send buffer size.

methods.name: SocketReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the socket's receive buffer size.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Resets internal byte counters for send and receive buffers.

methods.name: TTL
methods.description: Gets or sets the Time To Live (TTL) value for the socket.

methods.name: Broadcast
methods.description: Enables or disables broadcast on the socket.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Joins a multicast group.

methods.name: Leave
methods.description: Leaves a multicast group.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the socket with optional specific interface.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers socket event handling.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data through the socket.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the socket.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles socket state change events.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Sets the socket to listen for incoming connections.

methods.name: Accept (overload)
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection and retrieves remote node ID.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the socket port.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket.

methods.name: BufferAlignment
methods.description: Aligns the buffer for socket operations.

methods.name: ConstructSocket
methods.description: Constructs a socket with specified parameters.

methods.name: WaitForOpen
methods.description: Waits for socket to open.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits for socket to close.

methods.name: WaitForWriteComplete
methods.description: Waits for write operations to complete.
